title: Reign of Semiramis I (Merneith/Uenephes)
summary: CFAH AP-21: the reign of Semiramis I, 2036–1994 BC; CFAH-6 links her with Merneith/Uenephes of Egypt.
description: Semiramis is the widow of Ninus (Nimrod) in the classical sources. CFAH-6 Table 1 gives the start as 2036/2035 BC, and CFAH-6 Argument 2 §A links the end of the famine of Djoser to the death of Uenephes in 1994 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-21: Reign of Semiramis I: 2036–1994 B.C."; CFAH-6 Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #21 ("Start of the reign of Semiramis I", 2036/2035)
chronologies.note: CFAH-3 heading: "Reign of Semiramis I: 2036–1994 B.C."
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
